source.title: Next Week on XBOX: New Games for September 28 to October 2
source.evidenceText: Mike Nelson, XBOX Wire Editor September 25, 2026 · 10 min read Welcome to Next Week on XBOX! In this weekly feature we cover all the games coming soon to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass! Get more details on these upcoming games below and click their profiles for further info (release dates subject to change). Let’s jump in! Minecraft Dungeons II Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 564 ★★★★★ Get it now Minecraft Dungeons II – September 28Game Pass / XBOX Play Anywhere Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a thrilling new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Journey through unexplored lands and mysterious locations, in a quest to stop a new evil from causing chaos in not one, but two worlds! Clash with menacing foes in explosive encounters and fight your way through hordes of mobs that will do everything in their power to stop you! Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition Pre-Order Xbox Game Studios ☆☆☆☆☆ 3062 ★★★★★ Get it now Gears of War: E-Day Premium Edition – October 1XBOX Play Anywhere Experience the horror and brutality of Emergence Day. Fourteen years before the original Gears of War, join Marcus Fenix and Dominic Santiago in a gripping origin-story campaign as the Locust Horde first erupt from below, igniting a desperate fight for survival. Rally your squad and fight on in multiplayer with a reimagination of Gears’ iconic PvE mode, Horde Siege, or go head-to-head with a refined Versus PvP. Built from the ground up in Unreal Engine 5, Gears of War: E-Day delivers the most immersive Gears yet. ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE Pre-Order Bandai Namco Entertainment America Inc. ☆☆☆☆☆ 282 ★★★★★ Get it now Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve – October 2Step into the cockpit and take flight as an elite pilot across stunning skies. Enter intense dogfights, eliminate threats, and rise through gripping missions to earn your wings in this game developed by PROJECT ACES, the acclaimed team behind the franchise. Early Access starts September 28 for those who pre-order the Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve Deluxe Edition. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered CD PROJEKT RED ☆☆☆☆☆ 6653 ★★★★★ $49.99 Get it now Xbox One X Enhanced The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered – September 29XBOX Play Anywhere Free upgrade for all owners of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt. Discover the definitive version of the award-winning dark fantasy role-playing game on September 29. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered brings an array of improvements and modernizations to visuals, gameplay, character progression, and much more. Remastered also includes the acclaimed Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. Gothic II Complete Classic THQ Nordic ☆☆☆☆☆ 17 ★★★★★ $29.99 Get it now Gothic II Complete Classic – September 28 Gothic II Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the expansion Night of the Raven. You have torn down the magical barrier and freed the prisoners of the Valley of Mines. Now the former convicts roam the forests and mountains, causing trouble around the city of Khorinis. Way of the Hunter 2 THQ Nordic ☆☆☆☆☆ 126 ★★★★★ Get it now Way of the Hunter 2 – September 28 Feel the thrill of the hunt and keep an eye out for the wild and wonderous species that are roaming the wilderness. Hunt in North America and display big game like Moose, Elk, Bears, and Bison as well as, smaller animals like Rabbits, Turkeys and various other birds. DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Complete Edition Remastered KOEI TECMO AMERICA ☆☆☆☆☆ 94 ★★★★★ Get it now Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered – October 1 A striking revival of DYNASTY WARRIORS 3 and DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends, which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Experience even more enjoyable and thrilling action as you aim for the peak of 1 vs. 1,000! End of Abyss Epic Games Publishing ☆☆☆☆☆ 99 ★★★★★ $29.99 Get it now Free Trial End of Abyss – October 1 In the depths of a mysterious underground compound, a mission to investigate disturbances of unknown origin spirals into a harrowing descent through a broken and abandoned world. Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility’s derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them. Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts Samustai LTD ☆☆☆☆☆ 6 ★★★★★ $34.99 Get it now Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts – October 1XBOX Play Anywhere Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts offers a unique opportunity to design and build countless variations of realistic looking warships combined with an extremely in-depth combat model. Recreate famous ships such as the HMS Dreadnought and countless speculative designs. Experiment and enjoy naval battles utilizing endless combinations of ship designs in technology eras between the years 1890 and 1950 for ten different nations. Keep Driving YCJY Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 13 ★★★★★ $17.99 Get it now Keep Driving – September 28 An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time. Blades & Battles QUByte Interactive ☆☆☆☆☆ 1 ★★★★★ $14.99 $12.74 Get it now Blades & Battles – September 28XBOX Play Anywhere Blades & Battles combines the spirit of ‘90s arcades with the fluidity of modern combat. Explore a fantasy world inspired by Arthurian legends and prove your skill against colossal bosses. Fight solo or invite a friend for local co-op and relive the glory of couch co-op battles. Lost in Loss Soroka Games ☆☆☆☆☆ 2 ★★★★★ $9.99 Get it now Lost in Loss – September 28XBOX Play Anywhere Hey, Detective! Ready for a strange case? source.title: Warhammer Survivors launches November 10, new characters revealed
source.evidenceText: October 6, 2026October 6, 2026 Warhammer Survivors launches November 10, new characters revealed 7 0 42 Like this A glimpse at two newly announced characters and their devastating weapons. Ellie Harrodine Designer, Auroch Digital Today, we’re excited to announce that Warhammer Survivors launches on PS5 November 10. To mark the occasion we’re also revealing two characters in our latest trailer. Play Video Eagle-eyed fans who have been following the game for a while may have noticed Morvenn Vahl in the game’s key art, and we’re really excited to show her off in full pixel art glory finally. Warhammer Survivors allows you to play in both the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universe, so her counterpart (as part of today’s reveal) is Lyssa Revenya, a skilled thief and tomb-robber. While both champions take prime position in today’s spotlight, they couldn’t be more different. Who is Morvenn Vahl? Formerly a young Celestian Superior, Morvenn Vahl was chosen to become High Abbess Sanctorum – supreme commander of Adepta Sororitas. Vahl is an iron-willed warrior, suffering no fools and certainly no heretics. Dissatisfied with commanding from the safety of the Imperium, Vahl spearheads many crusades personally, leading from the front. How does she destroy the endless swarms of Tyranids, Death Guard Plague Marines, and Orks? As one of our larger Warhammer Survivors characters, Vahl strides across the battlefield in her ornate Paragon Warsuit. She’s armed with the devastating Heavy Bolter Fidelis, which sprays an arc of projectiles obliterating her foes. The weapon also has a chance to trigger a miracle, blessing Vahl and increasing the weapon’s rate of fire. Fidelis can be evolved to the Purgator Mirabilis, which unlocks the use of the warsuit’s Paragon Missile Launcher, unleashing a sporadic salvo of explosions across the battlefield – in addition to Fidelis’ spray of bolter shells. Enemies of Imperium, beware! Thief, Tomb-Robber, Saviour of Cinderfall – who is Lyssa Revenya? We’re moving to the Mortal Realms next. Lyssa Revenya is a talented thief and an integral member of the Saviours of Cinderfall, a rag-tag band of heroes who scoured the streets of Hammerhal and put an end to those plotting the city’s demise. Originally hailing from Lethis, Lyssa is well-versed in the art of navigating trap-ridden crypts and catacombs of that morbid city. Lyssa’s unique toolset for breaking and entering – and slaying hordes of Skaven In Warhammer Survivors, Lyssa turns her signature tools for breaking and entering into weapons. The Rope and Grapnel shoot hooks in from random edges of the screen, colliding with specific points on the battlefield, damaging enemies and dragging away any who survive. It’s the perfect weapon for a nimble thief who likes to stay more than a sword-length from their enemies. When the Rope and Grapnel evolves, Lyssa communes with the spirit of Rhea, a former ally and mentor. This terrifying, screaming banshee soars across the battlefield, exploding into a vengeful cloud of damaging ghostly fog. Perhaps in the right hands, Lyssa’s Rope and Grapnel can be utilised to pull enemies toward the Ghost of Rhea’s vengeful uproars? There’s only one way to find out. Warhammer Survivors launches on November 10; Morvenn Vahl and Lyssa Revenya are just two of over 40 playable champions waiting for you in-game. You can wishlist and pre-order on PlayStation 5 starting today, and PlayStation Plus members will receive a 10% discount when pre-ordering. Auroch DigitalWarhammer Survivors Did you like this? source.title: Critical Role joins Rockbeasts, launching January 2027
source.evidenceText: October 8, 2026October 9, 2026 Critical Role joins Rockbeasts, launching January 2027 4 0 28 Like this Matthew Mercer and Sam Riegel join the cast. Bartosz Pieczonka Creative Director / Co-CEO, Lichthund Since the very beginning, we knew Rockbeasts was something special. To us, at least. Not because it’s the biggest game, or the safest bet. Quite the opposite. It’s not built around a genre you can neatly file it under. It’s built around a theme, a very specific fantasy that comes straight from our own experiences and our own love of music – and how it shaped us. That’s what makes it special. It’s also exactly what makes it hard. For anyone just discovering us: Rockbeasts is a rock and roll management RPG. You’re not the frontman, not the drummer, but the manager. Your job is to take a band from a garage full of ego, feedback, and half-finished songs, all the way to the biggest stages out there. Along the way, you’ll juggle resources, wrangle personalities, put out fires (sometimes literal ones), and try to keep the whole beautiful mess together long enough to make it big. Games like this, the ones driven by feeling rather than formula, don’t play nice with algorithms. They’re harder to pitch, harder to categorize, harder to put in front of the people who’d actually love them. We knew that going in. We also knew that if this idea ever got the right support behind it, it could become something much bigger than what we could build alone. That support has arrived. We’re beyond proud to share that Lichthund is partnering with Critical Role, both creatively and on the publishing side. Their experience, talent and honestly, their taste for stories with real heart, combined with everything we’ve poured into our game, is exactly the combination we always hoped for. This partnership is what should let Rockbeasts become the game we always wanted it to be, instead of the game we had to settle for. It took us a moment to get here. And there’s still a lot we need to handle as we want to make Rockbeasts the best version of itself. But we’re ready. As if we were to enter a rock stage ourselves.Matthew Mercer and Sam Riegel will share that stage with us, as they are officially joining Rockbeasts’s cast. Seeing our characters played by them is a dream come true. If you know Critical Role (and if you don’t, please do yourself a favor and check them out), you know what these two bring to a character: chaos, heart, and a level of commitment that makes a script feel like a true adventure. That’s exactly the energy our game needs, because managing a band this unhinged was never going to be a quiet job. And there’s more to come, so please stay with us on this last mile leading to the release – and here’s the second, equally exciting part… Rockbeasts launches on PS5 in January 2027! That’s when you’ll finally get to sit in the manager’s chair, wrangle your own beautifully broken band, and try to get them to the stage they deserve – in one piece, if you’re lucky. We’ve been building toward this moment for a long time. For those of you already with us – thank you from the bottom of our hearts for believing in something a little different. For those we’re just about to meet – welcome and enjoy the tour. You can wishlist Rockbeasts now in preparation for launch in January 2027. LichthundRockbeasts Did you like this?
